text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened when I attended a public 
lecture with Agnes Tachyon, thinking, 
"This might help come up with training 
menus."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-kun. It seems this 
university is currently holding a campus 
tour.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Since I've come all the way to the top 
academic institution, I might as well see 
what kind of research environment they 
have.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, I ended up joining the campus 
tour along with Agnes Tachyon."

text_block_list.name: Guide
text_block_list.text:
Our university library houses all kinds of 
academic books and research papers related 
to sports science!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho...! "The Correlation Between Emotion 
and the Physical Body" and "Biomechanics 
of Umamusume"...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku! Looks like this could be applied 
to a physical enhancement chemical 
formula!

text_block_list.name: Guide
text_block_list.text:
Our university's sports arena is an 
all-weather dome! It can simulate various 
natural phenomena like rain, fog, and 
snow!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho! So you can configure the weather 
conditions completely at will!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! With this, we might even be able 
to conduct communication experiments under 
extreme conditions!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! A pressurized training room and a 
circular current pool! There's even a 
scanning electron microscope room!

text_block_list.name: Guide
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This is our university's prized 
research lab! All of the equipment is 
state-of-the-art!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha!! Splendid!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Cognitive function tests under pressurized 
conditions, and microscopic observations 
of enhanced cells! I can conduct any 
research my heart desires!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Man, what a truly thrilling tour that was!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To think there was a future where I went 
to school here—it really brings out all 
the feelings!
choice_data_list: What!? ...'A future going to school here'?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Remember when I was almost expelled? I had 
prepared multiple alternatives for where 
to go next.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This university was one of the candidates. 
I happen to have a few connections there, 
you see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was the one who gave her the reason to 
stay at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However... during the tour, she was full 
of life.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regarding not choosing a life of 
university research—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine even if I can't run at the 
academy..." That's what I used to think 
back then.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, the research environment 
here is thoroughly equipped. Experiment 
ideas just keep welling up one after 
another.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yet none of them can be realized. No 
matter how many simulations I run, 
something is missing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There is an indispensable condition, you 
see.
choice_data_list: What in the world is that...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku... Well then, shall we head back, 
Trainer-kun?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, all sorts of experiments came to 
mind that I'd like to try.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't grasp what conditions Agnes 
Tachyon was talking about or what she 
intended. Even so, wanting to do whatever 
I could, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh? What is the matter, Trainer-kun?
choice_data_list: I really wanted to give this to you.
I wanted to give this to you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh, isn't this the thesis I saw at 
that university! You went out of your way 
to track it down for me?
choice_data_list: Because you seemed so interested in it.
Because you seemed really curious about it

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku! Your spirit of service... no, 
guinea pig spirit truly commands my 
respect.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Still, thanks to this, it looks like I'll 
be able to create a new medicine.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
When it is complete... you will help me, 
of course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What was Agnes Tachyon thinking? As I 
pondered the answer on my way home—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Right. We're taking a little detour, 
Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I need to gather materials for a new 
experiment. Plus, I'd like to buy some 
more black tea.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll tag along with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Seeing her enjoying her everyday life 
like this, I vowed in my heart to do 
everything in my power to support her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't grasp what conditions Agnes 
Tachyon was talking about or what she 
intended. Even so, wanting to do whatever 
I could, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh? What is the matter, Trainer-kun?
choice_data_list: I really wanted to give this to you.
I wanted to give this to you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Is this... a permit to use that 
university's facilities? How did you 
manage to get your hands on this?"
choice_data_list:
After persuading all kinds of people, 
somehow...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku! Your spirit of service... no, 
guinea pig spirit truly commands my 
respect.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Still, thanks to that, it looks like I'll 
be able to run an interesting experiment.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The test subject, of course, is you. 
You'll cooperate with me, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What was Agnes Tachyon thinking? As I 
pondered the answer on my way home—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Right. We're taking a little detour, 
Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I need to gather materials for a new 
experiment. Plus, I'd like to buy some 
more black tea.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll tag along with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Seeing her enjoying her everyday life 
like this, I vowed in my heart to do 
everything in my power to support her.
